definition: μηδέ  negative particle, related to οὐδέ as μή to οὐ,  __1. as conic., continuing a negation or prohibition, but not, and not, nor: preceded by μή, Mat.6:25 22:29, Mrk.12:24, Luk.14:12, al.; ἵνα μή, Jhn.4:15; ὅπως μή, Luk.16:26; μηδέ . . . μηδέ, neither . . . nor, Mat.10:10, 1Co.10:8-9.  __2. As adv., strengthening a negation, not even: Mrk.2:2, 1Co.5:11, al  (AS)
